https://rwst.github.io/Collatz-Map-Basics/
Blueprint formalizations of

  • basic lemmas about several functions/maps related to the Collatz conjecture
  • the paper by Rozier & Terracol (2025)

This is a human/AI collaboration product, not an autoformalization. Models used were Gemini-Pro, Gemini-Flash, Opus, Sonnett, and Aristotle. While blueprint lemmas/defs were AI-translated from Lean, I checked the units, and arranged them in the proper order to a satisfying document.

The goal for me was to get an understanding of the matter by working with the proofs, and to provide a base for any other Collatz formalization project.
